_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With the score in a 95% coil base rate and no breaker tripped (DXY intact, funding tepid, stablecoins flat), HOLD is the skilled call — a directional claim here requires seeing the breaker, and neither brain has confirmed one yet.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicitly calls HOLD forward; narrative implies UP. Judge sides with analyst's coil discipline and the 5% directional-move base rate.
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC funding rises above 0.015% with DXY breaking below 100 and stablecoin growth turning positive — signals Hope transition and validates LONG
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes above 20 with funding turning negative and BTC momentum_30d rolling over below 40 — signals retreat toward Panic and invalidates the bottom thesis
